source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 2.1 (PDF 23, printed 20).

blocks.text: Scalars woh physical quantities hain jo sirf miqdar (magnitude, yani size ya amount) se bayan ho jati hain; un mein simt (direction) ka koi zikr nahi hota. Is liye scalars ki koi simt nahi hoti, aur unhen ek adad aur us ke unit se poori tarah bataya ja sakta hai.

items: Mass: kisi cheez mein madde (matter) ki miqdar. Misal: 2 kg.
Distance: kisi cheez ka tay kiya hua poora rasta, simt ko dekhe baghair. Misal: 50 m.
Speed: kisi cheez ke faasla tay karne ki raftar. Misal: 40 km h⁻¹.
Time: waqeat (events) ka chalta hua silsila. Misal: 20 seconds.
Energy: kaam karne ki salahiyat. Misal: 25 J.
Temperature: kisi madde ke zarron (particles) ki ausat (average) kinetic energy ka paimana. Misal: 20°C.

blocks.prompt: Safar ke baad car ka odometer 50 km zyada dikhata hai aur speedometer zyada tar raste 40 km h⁻¹ dikhata raha. In mein se kaun si quantities scalar hain, aur kyun?
blocks.explanation: Dono scalar hain. Odometer tay kiya hua faasla (raste ki kul lambai) batata hai aur speedometer speed (faasla tay karne ki raftar). Dono mein se koi bhi nahi batata ke car kis taraf gayi, is liye dono mein simt nahi.

items: Scalar: sirf miqdar, yani unit ke saath ek adad; misalein: mass, distance, speed, time, energy, temperature.
